FN-GTLI262-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 260
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Kenyatte
Hassell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 260 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Unified Judicial System and
certain counties by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of cases that are
adjudicated in juvenile court as a result of the establishment of concurrent jurisdiction with the
United States for certain criminal offenses committed by juveniles on military installation within
the state.
